summary: A day-ledger for the owner and a pocket docket for animators: bookings read like ruled ledger lines, with the missing deposit as the one red stamp on the page.

world.name: Docket
world.summary: Paper-ledger operations tool: a warm off-white page, a deep indigo ink for structure, plum for the one accent action, ruled double-lines under every table head.
world.signature: A ledger tab: status chips get a die-cut notch on their left edge (clip-path), like a paper tab peeking from a binder, and header rules are doubled (a thin line under a thick one) the way a ruled ledger book prints its column heads.
rules: Do set section heads in PT Serif with a doubled rule beneath.
Do keep every card corner at radius-md, chips at radius-pill.
Don't fill any surface with the accent; it marks one action per screen.
Don't use solid red for anything but a missing deposit.

components.name: Page shell
components.what: The page's outer frame: the max-width column and padding every screen sits inside.

components.name: App top bar
components.what: Persistent header with the PartyFox brand mark and the current role or day, shown on every screen including phone.

components.name: Page header
components.what: A screen's title, with a trailing action when the screen needs one: a status chip on Booking, a search field on Customers.

components.name: Status chip
components.what: Pill label with a die-cut notch, in ok, warning, danger or neutral tone, on bookings, orders, leave requests and pay rows.

components.name: Stat tile
components.what: Labelled number tile, one per count: the day's totals on Operations day, the month's totals on My pay.

components.name: Day schedule
components.what: The day's bookings and leave arranged as a time-by-animator grid on desktop and laptop, or a time-ordered list on phone; holds one Party ticket or Leave block per row.

components.name: Party ticket
components.what: One booking: time, child, age and package, with its ok, warning or missing-deposit status. Drawn as a grid block on the day schedule, a row in the phone agenda, and a full card on the animator's own parties, with the missing-deposit banner and leave-clash flag as its states.

components.name: Leave block
components.what: A placeholder on the day schedule marking an animator's approved leave, so that time reads as unavailable rather than empty.

components.name: Assign animator menu
components.what: Menu to see and change which animator covers a booking, or leave it unassigned; opened from a Party ticket.

components.name: Order card
components.what: One site order: child, parent, date, guests, address, status chip and one primary action (schedule, ask for address, or resolve a clash).

components.name: Button
components.what: Primary, ghost and danger action buttons: schedule, approve, decline, mark deposit received, remind, submit leave.

components.name: Card
components.what: A bordered section wrapper with a heading and content: the booking's steps, messages, facts, providers and deposit panels, and the two sections of the leave request screen.

components.name: Booking step list
components.what: The vertical stepper listing a booking's path from order to party day; holds one Booking step per stage.

components.name: Booking step
components.what: One stage of a booking's path: done, next up, todo, or missing (red dot for a missing deposit).

components.name: Deposit alert panel
components.what: Warning-tinted panel on a booking with a missing deposit, showing the amount note and the mark-received and remind actions.

components.name: Confirm deposit received dialog
components.what: Confirms before marking a booking's deposit as received; opened from the deposit panel's button.

components.name: Customer facts list
components.what: Key-value list of a booking's customer facts: parent, phone, email, guests, address, animator and repeat history.

components.name: External providers list
components.what: The list of outside providers booked for a party; holds one Provider row per provider.

components.name: Provider row
components.what: One outside provider booked for a party: what they cover, who they are, and their confirmation state.

components.name: Message log
components.what: The list of timestamped messages exchanged with the customer about a booking; holds one Message per exchange.

components.name: Message
components.what: One timestamped message to or from the customer, with its channel.

components.name: Leave request card
components.what: One leave request: animator, dates or hours, reason, any bookings it affects, and either an approve/decline pair or a decided chip.

components.name: Decline leave dialog
components.what: Asks the owner for a note before declining an animator's leave request; opened from the decline button.

components.name: Customer card
components.what: One family: contact, repeat/large/new tags, a missing-deposit chip, children's birthdays and up to three past bookings.

components.name: Search field
components.what: Free-text search for a party, customer or family.

components.name: Birthday row
components.what: One child's upcoming birthday with the date, and an unbooked flag when no party is booked for it yet.

components.name: Form field
components.what: A label paired with its input or textarea, one per field on the leave request form.

components.name: Leave date picker
components.what: Picks the start and end date for a new leave request, replacing the plain from/to text fields.

components.name: Reason textarea
components.what: Optional free-text reason an animator adds to a new leave request.

components.name: My leave list row
components.what: One of the animator's own past leave requests, its dates or hours and reason, with a pending, approved or declined chip.

components.name: Pay history row
components.what: One party's pay for the month: child and package, date and state (done, today or upcoming), hours, and a missing-deposit chip when its deposit is unpaid.

components.name: Report pay error dialog
components.what: Lets an animator flag a mistake on one month's pay line for the owner to check; opened from that pay row.
